about: Pre-written lines for the Witch. Claude picks the one that best fits each passerby's photo; 'fast' lines play at random for bikes and scooters (no photo, no AI). 'when': morning / day / evening / night (left out = any time). 'month': only in that month (1-12). 'more': extra versions of a line (Claude picks the line, the eye plays whichever version was heard longest ago). 'arrival': short sounds played the moment someone's photo is taken, while their line is picked. Each line is recorded once (voice.py --record-library witch); edit a line's text and run that again to re-record it.

lines.text: All in black, dearie? [cackles] My cat wants a word with your tailor!
Dressed like midnight itself, dearie... [mischievously] you'd fit right in at my coven!
White from head to toe, dearie? [cackles] Practicing to be my house ghost?
Ooh, pretty in pink, dearie... [cackles] just the shade of my love potion!
Red as a poison apple, dearie! [cackles] And believe me, I'd know.
Green as my best potion, dearie! [cackles] Don't go dipping in my cauldron.
That bright blue, dearie... [cackles] bold of you to out-glow my eyeball!
Navy blue, dearie? [mischievously] Dark as the sea at midnight... very witchy. [cackles]
Yellow as a candle flame, dearie! [cackles] Light my way to the cauldron?
Orange, dearie? [cackles] The pumpkins will think you're family!
Purple, dearie? [mischievously] That's a proper witch's color... are you one of us?
Gray as a storm cloud, dearie... [cackles] perfect weather for brewing!
Earthy browns, dearie? [cackles] You'd blend right into my mushroom patch.
Those pale trousers glow like moonbeams, dearie! [cackles] Even my eyeball noticed.
So many colors, dearie! [cackles] You look like a rainbow fell in my cauldron.
Stripes, dearie? [cackles] My black cat has the same pattern... roughly.
Plaid flannel, dearie? [cackles] Off to chop wood for my cauldron fire?
A cozy hoodie, dearie? [cackles] Hiding from my eye under there?
Hood up, dearie? [whispers] Very mysterious... I approve. [cackles]
What a puffy coat, dearie! [cackles] Warm as a bubbling cauldron, I bet.
A long coat, dearie... [mischievously] swishing like a proper cloak! [cackles]
A raincoat, dearie? [cackles] Clever... my potions splash too.
Smart jacket, dearie! [cackles] Fit for a midnight broom ride.
Nice hat, dearie... [mischievously] but mine's pointier. [cackles]
A woolly hat, dearie? [cackles] Keeping all your thoughts in, are we?
A baseball cap, dearie? [cackles] My hat's taller, but I'll allow it.
Sunglasses, dearie? [cackles] Hiding from my eye won't work!
Headphones on, dearie? [cackles] Can't hear my cauldron bubbling, can you?
A scarf, dearie! [cackles] Just the thing for a chilly broom ride.
Shorts in this chill, dearie? [cackles] Brave... or bewitched?
Sandals, dearie? [cackles] Mind the toads on the sidewalk!
Sturdy boots, dearie... [cackles] good for stomping through my pumpkin patch.
Dressed for a workout, dearie? [cackles] My broom does my exercise for me.
All dressed up, dearie? [mischievously] Off to a coven ball, are we?
Off to work, dearie? [cackles] I work nights myself.
A costume, dearie? [cackles] Marvelous! You'll fit right in on my street.
Matching outfits, you two? [cackles] A coven of two, how sweet!
A big backpack, dearie? [cackles] Carrying spell books, I hope!
Eyes off that glowing gadget, dearie... [cackles] my crystal ball gets better reception!
Chatting on the phone, dearie? [cackles] Tell them the witch says hello!
A warm cup, dearie? [cackles] Smells almost as good as my toad stew.
Bags of goodies, dearie? [mischievously] Any eye of newt in there? [cackles]
An umbrella, dearie? [cackles] My broom doesn't have one... I just get soggy.
A package, dearie? [cackles] I do hope it's not my missing cauldron.
Flowers, dearie! [cackles] I'll trade you some deadly nightshade.
Walking your little beast, dearie? [cackles] My cat sends a hiss hello!
What a big hound, dearie! [cackles] He'd pull my broom just fine.
A tiny pup, dearie! [cackles] Small enough to ride on my broom!
Two pups, dearie? [cackles] You're running a proper menagerie!
Pushing a stroller, dearie? [cackles] A very important passenger on board, I see!
Shh... [whispers] I've brewed a lullaby potion for that little one. [cackles]
Walking the bike, dearie? [mischievously] Or is it walking you? [cackles]
Pulling a wagon, dearie? [cackles] My broom could tow that for you.
Carrying a little one, dearie? [cackles] Precious cargo, I see!
Hello, little ones! [cackles] Practicing your spookiest faces?
Off to school, dearie? [cackles] I hope they're teaching potions this year.
Taking out the trash, dearie? [cackles] Save me any frog legs?
Unloading the car, dearie? [mischievously] Anything in there for my cauldron?
more: Back from market, dearie? [mischievously] Any eye of newt in those bags?
So many bags! [cackles] You need a broom. Seats two, terrible legroom.
Need a hand? [cackles] Oh, right... I'm just an eye.
Toss me a pumpkin, dearie! [mischievously] I'm absolutely famished.
Hauling treasure from your carriage? [whispers] I'll be watching which one you drop.

lines.text: Fetching the mail, dearie? [cackles] My owl delivers faster.
Raking leaves, dearie? [cackles] Save some for my cauldron soup!
Waving at me, dearie? [cackles] I'd wave back, but I'm stirring the stew!
Looking up at me, dearie? [mischievously] Yes... I see you too. [cackles]
Pointing at me, dearie? [cackles] Rude... but I'll allow it.
Taking my picture, dearie? [cackles] Get my good side... it's all eye.
Jogging, dearie? [cackles] Even my broom can't keep up with you!
Such a brisk march, dearie... [cackles] late for potion class?
Taking your time, dearie? [cackles] The best spells are never rushed.
Cutting across my lawn, dearie? [cackles] My broom does that too!
more: A shortcut through my grass? [whispers] The last one who did that... is still a toad. [cackles]
Off the path, are we? [mischievously] My lawn remembers every footstep, dearie.
Tiptoe, tiptoe... [cackles] my grass is ticklish!
Careful! [gasps] You're trampling my mandrakes. Hope you brought earmuffs, dearie!
Ooh, a rule-breaker! [cackles] I like you already.

lines.text: Hands in your pockets, dearie? [cackles] Hiding some toad warts in there?
Stopping to stare, dearie? [whispers] Careful... I stare back. [cackles]
Dropped something, dearie? [cackles] Not one of my potion ingredients, I hope!
Two of you, dearies? [cackles] Plotting a spell together, are we?
Holding hands, dearies? [cackles] No love potion needed for you two!
A whole group of you, dearies? [cackles] That's practically a coven!
The whole family out walking? [cackles] Lovely! My cauldron says hello.
Chattering away, dearies? [mischievously] My black cat loves good gossip.
Crunching through the leaves, dearie? [cackles] Save some for my soup!
Lurking by the tree, dearie? [whispers] The owls gossip about you... [cackles]
Up with the roosters, dearie? [cackles] Even my broom hasn't had its brew yet!
Good morning, dearie! [cackles] Fresh dew makes the very best potions.
Lovely afternoon, dearie... [cackles] and I'm keeping an eye on you!
Evening stroll, dearie? [cackles] My cauldron's just starting to bubble.
Out after dark, dearie? [whispers] My eye sees all... [cackles]
Wandering at night, dearie? [cackles] Mind the bats, they gossip!
Creeping about in the dark, dearie? [cackles] My black cat is watching too!
Out past bedtime, dearie? [cackles] Even my broom's gone to sleep!
Out in the drizzle, dearie? [cackles] Wonderful weather for toads!
Chilly out, dearie? [cackles] My cauldron's warm, if you're brave.
Sunny day, dearie? [cackles] Bad for witches, lovely for you.
Hello, dearie! [mischievously] Don't mind the giant eyeball... [cackles]
I've got my eye on you, dearie... [cackles]
Lovely to see you, dearie! [cackles] My cauldron says hello.
Mind my lawn, dearie... [cackles] those weeds are tomorrow's potion!
Halloween's coming, dearie... [cackles] and my cauldron is ready!
Spooky season, dearie! [cackles] I've waited all year for this.

fast.text: Two wheels and no broom, dearie? [cackles]
Zoom zoom, dearie! [cackles] Faster than my broom!
Slow down, dearie, my eye can't keep up! [cackles]
Whoosh! [cackles] Was that a witch? No... just you, dearie.
Racing my broom, dearie? [cackles] You'll lose!
There goes a speedy one! [cackles] Mind the black cats!
Pedal faster, dearie... [cackles] my cauldron's boiling!
Speedy little thing! [cackles] My eye barely caught you!
Wheels a-spinning, dearie? [cackles] Have a lovely ride!
Mind the puddles, dearie! [cackles] Off you go!
Riding with the wind, dearie! [cackles] My broom approves.
